properties.name: marz.enabled
properties.description: Enable MARZ auto-configuration. Set to false to disable all MARZ processing.

properties.name: marz.safety-net-interval-ms
properties.description: Safety-net CRC32 check interval in milliseconds. WatchService is the primary event-driven mechanism; this runs as insurance. Minimum 500ms.

properties.name: marz.default-source
properties.description: Default config source URI for fields using platform://marz source.

properties.name: marz.platform.api-key
properties.description: Platform API key. The agent only activates when this is set.

properties.name: marz.platform.environment
properties.description: Environment label (production/staging/dev). Falls back to spring.profiles.active.

properties.name: marz.platform.reconnect-max-delay-ms
properties.description: Maximum reconnect backoff delay in milliseconds.
